style_spec.name: Pixel Blueprint
style_spec.layout_rule: Content-driven: match the layout to the release's actual scope (1x1 hero schematic for one flagship feature, 1x2 split for two pillars or before/after, 1x3 columns or 1+2 bento for three highlights, 2x2 only when a release genuinely has four equal pillars like 0.1.0). Never pad filler panels.

cospan-0.1.0-overview.png.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: landscape (3:2) software release header overview image for Cospan 0.1.0.
Style/composition reference: first inspect `assets/design.png` and `assets/icon-128.png` using `view_image` as visual style references ONLY (pixel-crisp stepped chamfered card frames, hard flat pixel drop shadows, `#F8F9FA` light drafting dot-grid backdrop, `#3B35B5` indigo corner crosshairs, crisp pixel accents in emerald `#00C48C`, sky cyan `#00B4FF`, coral `#D97757`, indigo `#3B35B5`, yellow `#FFE03D`, and the exact Cospan bridge-arch pixel mark from `assets/design.png` / `assets/icon-128.png`). Do NOT copy the old center-bridge diagram layout; create a clean 2x2 four-panel release overview poster instead.

Use built-in `image_gen` without asking for confirmation, copy the final PNG to `releases/assets/cospan-0.1.0-overview.png`, and report the saved path.

Scene/backdrop: flat 2D `#F8F9FA` drafting dot-grid canvas with subtle `#DADCE0` dots and `#3B35B5` crosshair marks in corners. Crisp stepped-pixel chamfered white cards with flat stepped `#CBD0D6` / `#E4E7EB` pixel borders and shadows. Generous whitespace, zero gradients, zero 3D, zero blurry strokes, zero watermarks.

Top header:
- Exact title: `cospan 0.1.0` in bold crisp geometric sans-serif (`#202124`) beside the Cospan pixel bridge-arch logo mark (indigo square with emerald & cyan arches and yellow center diamond).
- Exact subtitle pill: `Unified orchestration across coding agents` in clean monospace (`#3B35B5`).

2x2 grid of four equally weighted pixel-chamfered cards:
1. Top-left card (emerald `#00C48C` top pixel bar):
   Heading: `4-Harness Async Adapter`
   Tiny pixel icon of 4 linked nodes.
   Lines:
   - `agy • codex • claude • dsh`
   - `Detached send / wait / observe`
   - `Multi-turn continue`
2. Top-right card (sky cyan `#00B4FF` top pixel bar):
   Heading: `Verbatim Model × Effort`
   Tiny pixel slider/tag icon.
   Lines:
   - `sol • carbon • fable • v4.1-flash`
   - `3-layer sparse config.json`
   - `Zero host model guessing`
3. Bottom-left card (coral `#D97757` top pixel bar):
   Heading: `Unified Sidebar & Worktrees`
   Tiny pixel sidebar-panel icon.
   Lines:
   - `Live board in agy & dsh`
   - `Git worktree family (wt:*)`
   - `Out-of-tree trajectories`
4. Bottom-right card (indigo `#3B35B5` top pixel bar):
   Heading: `MCP + Zero-Drift Contracts`
   Tiny pixel terminal/shield icon.
   Lines:
   - `Bundled stdio cospan_* MCP`
   - `--help flag contract check`
   - `24h TTL update notice`

Bottom workflow ribbon (4 stepped pixel pills connected by crisp arrows):
`Send` → `Wait / Observe` → `Wakeup` → `Continue`
Footer below ribbon:
`Antigravity • Codex • Claude Code • DeepSeek Harness`

Constraints: English text only, spell every word and flag verbatim, sharp legible typography, no tiny unreadable footnotes, no red crosses.

cospan-0.1.1-overview.png.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: landscape (3:2) software release header overview image for Cospan 0.1.1.
Style/composition reference: first inspect `releases/assets/cospan-0.1.0-overview.png`, `assets/design.png`, and `assets/icon-128.png` using `view_image` as visual style references ONLY (matching the exact Pixel Blueprint design language: pixel-crisp stepped chamfered card frames, hard flat pixel drop shadows, `#F8F9FA` light drafting dot-grid backdrop with `#DADCE0` dots, `#3B35B5` indigo corner crosshairs, crisp pixel accents in emerald `#00C48C`, sky cyan `#00B4FF`, coral `#D97757`, indigo `#3B35B5`, yellow `#FFE03D`, and the exact Cospan bridge-arch pixel mark from `assets/icon-128.png`). Do NOT copy the 2x2 four-card layout from 0.1.0; use a clean, focused 1x1 hero schematic layout tailored to this single flagship feature.

Use built-in `image_gen` without asking for confirmation, copy the final PNG to `releases/assets/cospan-0.1.1-overview.png`, and report the saved path.

Scene/backdrop: flat 2D `#F8F9FA` drafting dot-grid canvas with subtle `#DADCE0` dots and `#3B35B5` pixel crosshair marks in the four corners. Generous whitespace, crisp stepped-pixel chamfered white cards with flat `#CBD0D6` / `#E4E7EB` pixel borders and drop shadows. Zero gradients, zero 3D, zero blurry strokes, zero watermarks.

Top header:
- Exact title: `cospan 0.1.1` in bold crisp geometric sans-serif (`#202124`) beside the Cospan pixel bridge-arch logo mark (indigo square with emerald & cyan arches and yellow center diamond).
- Exact subtitle pill (stepped pixel outline in `#3B35B5`): `Gemini 4 Neon is in` in clean monospace (`#3B35B5`).

Center 1x1 Hero Card (single wide stepped-pixel chamfered white card with a crisp sky cyan `#00B4FF` top pixel bar):
- Left side of card:
  - Crisp stepped-pixel glowing prism/spark emblem in `#3B35B5`, `#00B4FF`, `#00C48C`, and `#FFE03D` inside a square light-gray pixel frame.
  - Bold heading beneath or beside icon: `Gemini 4 Neon` (`#202124`)
  - Monospace shortcut badge: `--model neon` (`#3B35B5` text on `#F1F3F4` pixel pill)
  - Clean monospace caption: `Antigravity (agy) · default medium`
- Center horizontal pixel arrow (`#3B35B5`) pointing right from `--model neon` to the effort stack.
- Right side of card (4 clean horizontal stepped-pixel rows stacked vertically showing deterministic effort resolution):
  1. Pill `low` (`#5F6368`) → `gemini-4-neon-low`
  2. Pill `medium` (emerald `#00C48C` accent border) → `gemini-4-neon-medium`
  3. Pill `high` (`#3B35B5` accent border) → `gemini-4-neon-high`
  4. Pill `xhigh` (sky cyan `#00B4FF` bar & `#FFE03D` pixel spark dot) → `gemini-4-neon-xhigh`

Bottom status strip (3 clean stepped-pixel pills connected or evenly spaced):
- `Verbatim --model neon` • `Full xhigh Effort` • `Synced Skills & MCP`
Footer below strip in crisp dark sans-serif:
`Antigravity • Codex • Claude Code • DeepSeek Harness`

Constraints: English text only, spell every word, flag, and model ID verbatim, sharp legible typography, balanced whitespace, no filler panels, no tiny unreadable footnotes, no red crosses.
